calendarNotes: The 2028–29 CCSD All Schools calendar starts students on August 14, 2028, after teacher work days from August 7–11. Fall Break is October 16–20. K–8 non-contact or conference dates include November 10, March 1–2, and May 4. K–12 non-contact dates include November 22, January 8, and February 20. Winter Break runs December 22–January 5, with the second semester beginning January 9. Spring Break runs March 19–23, and the last student day is May 25.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2027–28
content: The first student day moves two days earlier, from August 16 to August 14.
The last student day moves one day earlier, from May 26 to May 25.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cherry Creek School District start in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day on the 2028–29 All Schools calendar is Monday, August 14, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cherry Creek Winter Break in 2028–29?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2028, through January 5, 2029. January 8 is a K–12 non-contact day, and the second semester begins January 9, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Cherry Creek school in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day on the All Schools calendar is Friday, May 25, 2029.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the CCSD K–8 conference dates in 2028–29?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF marks November 10, 2028, March 1–2, 2029, and May 4, 2029, as K–8 non-contact or conference dates.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the difference between K–12 and K–8 non-contact dates?
calendarFaqs.a: K–12 non-contact dates apply to students in grades K–12. K–8 non-contact or conference dates apply to elementary and middle school students, while high schools may follow a different schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this calendar include school-specific Cherry Creek events?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page summarizes the All Schools calendar. Check your assigned school or program calendar for A/B schedules, testing, exams, graduation, and campus-specific events.
